name: Brie
source:
After failing to take a magical entity seriously, Brie sarcastically asked to be able to summon cheese sandwiches out of thin air. She could have asked for heat vision or the ability to fly or any other awesome power, but she thought the whole thing was a joke and now she's stuck with quite possibly the worst power set ever invented.
Brie feels understandably ripped off about the whole situation, especially considering she can't even summon different types of sandwiches, they specifically have to be grilled cheese. She's still committed to fighting evil and saving the world, but she's going to need a hell of a lot of help if she's even going to stand a chance against these invading octopus girls.
